scripts.pretest:e2e:staging:
node -e "const u=process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL||process.env.STAGING_BASE_URL;if(!u){console.error('[e2e] STAGING_BASE_URL (or PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL) is not set: there is no staging host to test.
  The staging project is only created when a staging URL is set, so Playwright would otherwise fail with: Project(s) staging not found.
  Re-run as:  STAGING_BASE_URL=https://staging.example.com STAGING_E2E_PASSWORD=<secret> npm run test:e2e:staging');process.exit(1)}if(!process.env.STAGING_E2E_PASSWORD){console.error('[e2e] STAGING_E2E_PASSWORD is not set: refusing to run the staging smoke spec.
  It registers real accounts on a shared, publicly reachable database and never deletes them, so it must not use the password published in this repository.
  Re-run as:  STAGING_E2E_PASSWORD=<secret> npm run test:e2e:staging');process.exit(1)}"
